units.source_text: 紫姬送来的衣服，色彩与式样都非常雅观。

en.t: The clothes that Lady Murasaki had sent were very elegant in both color and style.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“此人事事擅长，使我如意称心。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "She is skilled in everything and satisfies my heart in every way.

units.source_text: 若无此变，现在我正可摒除一切烦恼，断绝一切牵累，

en.t: If this misfortune had not happened, I could now cast off all worries and sever every worldly attachment,
and spend peaceful days together with her."

units.source_text: 然而想到目前境遇，又不胜惋惜。

en.t: But when he thought of his present circumstances, he was filled again with regret.

units.source_text: 于是紫姬的面影昼夜常在眼前，片刻不离。

en.t: From then on, Lady Murasaki's image was always before his eyes day and night, never leaving him for a moment.

units.source_text: 相思到不堪忍耐之时，决心偷偷地将她迎接来此。

en.t: When his longing became unbearable, he resolved to secretly bring her here.

units.source_text: 然而立刻又想回来：生不逢辰，处此浊世，

en.t: Yet he immediately reconsidered: born in an unlucky time and living in this impure world,

units.source_text: 首先应该忏除前生罪障，岂可胡思梦想？

en.t: he should first repent and cleanse away the karmic sins of his former lives; how could he indulge in wild dreams?

units.source_text: 于是立刻斋戒沐浴，朝朝暮暮勤修佛事。

en.t: So he at once fasted, purified himself with bathing, and diligently performed Buddhist rites morning and evening.
